## Documentation Philosophy

Documentation is part of the product.

It should always be:

- Accurate
- Current
- Understandable
- Consistent
- Maintainable

Every architectural decision should be reflected in the documentation.

Every significant feature should include documentation.

Future engineers should be able to understand guavacheck simply by reading its documentation.
